messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Suppliers face unresponsive interfaces when trying to open or save documents, disrupting communication and task tracking. These interruptions delay resolution and create frustration across the workflow.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.041,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4136",
   "similarity": 0.039,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4138",
   "similarity": 0.038,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Configure global settings for your organisation within Keelwater, including default claim categories, notification preferences, and user permissions to ensure consistent workflows across teams.\", \"id\": 4138, \"name\": \"Organisation settings\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4132",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability.\", \"id\": 4132, \"name\": \"Activity timeline display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.035,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem concerns unresponsive interfaces when suppliers open or save documents. The most similar stories—bulk document upload (4127, completed), supplier address fields (4136), organisation settings (4138), activity timeline (4132, completed), and task list improvements (4134)—all address different problems; none address interface responsiveness or document open/save failures. No roadmap items are present in the evidence. The core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
